annotation.title_clean: Keynote Address by the Minister of Communications and Digital Technologies, Mondli Gungubele, at the AI Government Summit
annotation.title_en: Keynote Address by the Minister of Communications and Digital Technologies, Mondli Gungubele, at the AI Government Summit
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Minister of Communications and Digital Technologies, Republic of South Africa (Mondli Gungubele)
annotation.venue: AI Government Summit, University of Johannesburg
annotation.summary_en: Keynote speech by South Africa's Communications Minister at the April 2024 AI Government Summit, outlining the country's approach to AI policy: international cooperation, African Union and UN initiatives, multistakeholder partnerships, a draft National AI Policy, and an AI Expert Advisory Council and Task Force. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Policy must precede regulation; a draft National AI Policy will go through public comment and provincial seminars
An AI Expert Advisory Council will be appointed, with an AI Task Force headed by Prof Vukosi Marivate
Calls for multistakeholder PPP approach and localised institutional mechanisms
Urges cloud companies and universities to expand AI research centres and collaboration in Africa
Notes AI risks: disinformation, bias, surveillance, privacy violations
